description: React component for a login page with organization selection, email input, and authentication handling.

methods.name: handleFindOrgs
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with the entered email and auto-selects 'Kavia B2C' if available.

methods.name: handleOrganizationSelect
methods.description: Handles user selection of an organization from dropdown.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Performs login with selected organization, email, and password, handling success and error cases.
